description:
About Our Brand & Products

Bloom & Crown Beauty is dedicated to high-performance, professional-grade beauty solutions that people can use in the comfort of their own homes. We don’t just sell "products"; we sell confidence and time-saving rituals. Our flagship line focuses on "Beauty Tech"



What Makes Us Different

  • Result-Driven Design: We prioritize products that offer an "instant fix." If a customer can see a difference in one use, it’s a Bloom & Crown product.

  • Curated Quality: Unlike massive marketplaces, we vet every item for durability and safety, ensuring 60–70% profit margins for us and high satisfaction for the customer.

  • Customer-Centric: We focus on the "Pain-to-Power" journey—taking a common struggle (like rough skin or dull hair) and providing an affordable, salon-quality solution.

How Affiliates Can Earn

  • Competitive Commissions: Earn a 15% to 20% commission on every sale generated through your unique link.

  • High Conversion Rates: Because our products solve specific problems (like the callus remover), they have a high "impulse buy" factor.

  • Performance Bonuses: Affiliates who hit monthly milestones (e.g., 50+ sales) qualify for increased commission percentages or free product samples for future content.

How to Promote Us

  • The "Before & After" Method: This is our most successful strategy. Show the problem, use the product, and show the instant result.

  • TikTok & IG Reels: Short-form video is king for beauty tech. Focus on satisfying "ASMR" style clips or "Get Ready With Me" (GRWM) routines.

  • Educational Hooks: Use captions like "Stop wasting $60 at the salon—do this at home instead" to highlight the cost-saving benefit of our products.

Other Information

  • Shipping & Support: We utilize streamlined logistics (via AutoDS/CJ Dropshipping) to ensure tracking numbers are provided quickly.

  • Creative Assets: Approved affiliates get access to a folder of high-quality product images, raw video footage, and top-performing ad copy to help them get started immediately.
